subject: Gateway-authorized Field Collector device mutations carry current-owner transaction context

ruff.command: .venv/bin/ruff check services/common/tenant_context.py services/mobile/api.py services/gateway/app.py tests/test_tenant_context.py tests/test_mobile_api.py

coverage: The Gateway marker binds the authenticated mobile_device resource, action, and normalized location to the mutation request.
Enrollment creation, enrollment revocation, and device revocation set current-owner context before their writes in the same transaction.
The current active owner is share-locked during each mutation context lookup.
Missing owner context is denied and the transaction rolls back before a write.
OIDC mutations continue to use tenant-qualified operator grants.
limitations: Gateway route authorization remains application-verified; the helper does not independently verify API-key or capability grants in PostgreSQL.
Transaction-local custom settings are not credentials when an application role can issue arbitrary SQL.
Pre-context device-token and one-time enrollment-code lookups, legacy CLI reads/writes, worker roles, and Directus/views remain open before RLS.
